description: Accept a backup another space shared with this one. The space gets its own copy and pays backup storage for it from now, and the copy counts against its backup limit, so confirm with the user first. Only the space's owner, or a member with Manage Backups, may accept. Refused with 422 when the space cannot take it (no card or credit, owner not verified, an open abuse notice, or no backup allowance left on its plan). Returns the share and the new backup.

spaceId.description: Krova Cloud Space id. Optional if KROVA_SPACE_ID is set as the server default.
